Subject: Fwd: HedgeCore invoice — recommended path for CRC discussion

Laura/Markus —

Looping you both in. HedgeCore has acknowledged the PO mismatch and expects to clear in ~10 business days, but this account is now 30+ days overdue and qualifies for a Credit Risk Committee review given size and enterprise terms.

Proposed approach for CRC meeting tomorrow:
- Quick review of outstanding balance and prior payment behavior (Marcus, pls include last 12 months of aging).
- Approve temporary hold on new feature rollouts if payment not received by 2027-06-14 (soft hold, communicated by AM).
- Define immediate negotiation levers: 30/60/90-day payment plan, partial credit, or contract pause.
- Decide exec contact cadence (I recommend we escalate to CFO if no payment by 2027-06-10).

Attached: Redwood_Collection_Playbook_v2.docx for CRC reference. Marcus — please bring the ledger export and the statement.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Credit Risk Committee <crc@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Credit Risk Committee: HedgeCore Capital — docs and recommendation

Team —

Summary for CRC packet:
- Account: HedgeCore Capital (HC-ENTERPRISE-03)
- Outstanding: $78,450 (INV-202705-349)
- Aging: 31 days
- Notes: Customer cites PO mismatch; procurement has acknowledged and is processing. Previous 12-month payment behavior: 2 late payments (15–20 days), otherwise on time.

Recommendation (vote):
1) Approve 10-business-day extension (new due date 2027-06-14) conditional on receiving confirmed PO number by 2027-06-08.
2) If no PO/partial payment by 2027-06-14, assign AM to issue soft feature hold and escalate to CFO for executive outreach.
3) Do not pursue legal collections at this stage; preserve customer relationship.

Please reply with your vote (approve/reject/modify).

Attachments: HedgeCore_Statement_202706.pdf, Redwood_Collection_Playbook_v2.docx

Thanks,
Avery

Appreciate the patience — internal PO was approved late yesterday (PO-99877). AP has scheduled a partial payment of $30,000 on 2027-06-11 and the remaining $48,450 on 2027-06-18. I’ve attached the PO and the payment confirmation stub. If you need a faster path, we can discuss a one-time wire.
